name: Port Blair

description.title: Port Blair – Tropical Gateway
description.short: Capital of Andaman & Nicobar Islands, known for beaches and history.
description.long: Port Blair, the capital of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, offers a perfect blend of history, culture, and tropical beauty. Known for its pristine beaches, vibrant marine life, and the historic Cellular Jail, it serves as the gateway to exotic island adventures, attracting travelers seeking relaxation, exploration, and unforgettable experiences.
description.history: Port Blair played a pivotal role during India's freedom struggle, with the Cellular Jail serving as a colonial prison for political prisoners. Its strategic location and rich cultural heritage make it a unique destination.
description.overview: A coastal city with lush landscapes, colonial architecture, and vibrant local life.

safetyInformation: Respect marine life and coral reefs.
Follow local guidelines during monsoon season.
travelTips: Try local seafood at Aberdeen Bazaar.
